title: Lava Solo #036 (흑요석 루비 용암 · 체형 hourglass bombshell · 인종 Korean · 메이크업 강남언니(강화) · 배경 숲길(비 갠 뒤) · 힐 40인치 · 몸 주얼리)

Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

Dense volcanic surface — BLAZING glossy black obsidian crust plates across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID deep ruby-red molten lava glowing in every crack, with orange glints and drifting embers, glassy volcanic, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Jewelry: a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, a long layered gold necklace falling between her breasts, and a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.

Background: a bright sun-dappled forest path with a packed earth floor, a waist-high wooden rail, a standard bench and tall straight trees, just after the rain, with wet surfaces shining softly, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
